one_liner: Devin has a REST v3 API with Bearer cog_ service-user keys or PATs and an official MCP server at mcp.devin.ai. API access likely needs a paid plan, and no OAuth is offered.
auth_notes: Service user API keys and personal access tokens, both with a cog_ prefix, are sent as a Bearer token. No OAuth2 flow for third-party apps appears in the evidence. Legacy apk_ keys are deprecated.
access_notes: The Free plan gives limited Devin usage. The Devin API is shown as a plan feature in the pricing table, and the quickstarts assume a Teams or Enterprise org with service users. The evidence does not say whether Free or Pro includes API access, so this is uncertain.
blocker_notes: Static tokens are tied to an org or user, and API access probably needs a paid plan. Multi-user OAuth is not available, so each customer must create and supply a service user key.

evidence.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format. Include your token in the `Authorization` header of every request
Personal Access Tokens (PATs) allow human users to authenticate programmatically under their own identity.
The Free plan lets you try Devin with limited usage.
Go to **Settings > Devin API** in your organization and open the **Service users** tab
The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
The Devin MCP server is an authenticated service that provides access to both public and private repositories, plus full platform management capabilities. **Base Server URL:** `https://mcp.devin.ai/`
